paragraphs.source_en: Phyllis loked non-plussed. "I don't know what to say to you, John. I'm kind of surprised. We don't know everything, to pretend we do is arrogance. The creation is mysterious. To give something a name like 'the big bang,' and then think you have an explanation-it's bad logic, bad thinking. Outside your rational scientific thought is an enormous area of consciousness, an area more important than science. Faith in God is part of that. And I suppose you either have it or you don't." She stood. "I hope it comes to you." She left the room.
